text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [When Digivolving] Activate 1 of the effects below. ・1 of your other Digimon may digivolve into a level 4 purple Digimon card with [Free] in its traits from your trash for the cost. ・This Digimon and one of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in your hand for the cost.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and one of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in your hand for the cost.
